notes: Draft configuration: Historical Wakefield Park main circuit retains the Northern cap, Eastern outer turn, inner hairpin and Southern return from a pinned 2018 independent source. The ride-day organizer identifies the former 2.2 km circuit and its ten-corner plan. The exact mapped route measures 2203.3 m against the catalogue scalar of 2321 m. This entry preserves that historical course; the venue was subsequently rebuilt and reopened with reprofiled corners in 2024. Modern alignment and direction remain unverified. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2203.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 52 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
